name: Guru Kumaresan
bio: Guru Kumaresan is a master of Silambattam with over 25 years of experience. He has trained hundreds of students across Tamil Nadu and is dedicated to preserving the traditional martial art form.

name: Guru Selvam
bio: Guru Selvam specializes in Kalaripayattu and has been teaching for 18 years. He is known for his expertise in weapon-based martial arts training.

name: Guru Rajan
bio: Guru Rajan is a senior instructor with 30 years of experience in Silambattam. He has conducted workshops across India and internationally.

name: Guru Priya
bio: Guru Priya is one of the leading female Silambattam instructors in Chennai. She specializes in training women and children in traditional martial arts.

name: Guru Muthu
bio: Guru Muthu has been practicing Silambattam for 20 years and specializes in advanced weapon forms including surul kambu and sedikuchi.

name: Guru Vasanth
bio: Guru Vasanth is a dedicated Kalaripayattu instructor from Thoothukudi. He has trained numerous students in traditional combat techniques.

name: Guru Suresh
bio: Guru Suresh is spreading Silambattam in Karnataka. He conducts regular workshops and training programs in Bangalore.
